thesis: The episode argues that EA possesses a stable, recurring revenue model driven by core franchises like FIFA and Star Wars, though its mobile business faces significant headwinds from privacy issues and declining user acquisition efficiency. Conversely, Take-Two is viewed as a strategic liability due to its declining mobile assets and lack of a pipeline to offset weaknesses.
